examples: I'll be frank with you: the project is behind schedule and over budget.
با تو صریح خواهم بود: پروژه از برنامه عقب افتاده و از بودجه هم فراتر رفته است.
Her frank opinion about the restaurant's service surprised the owner.
نظر صریح او درباره خدمات رستوران، صاحب آن را شگفت‌زده کرد.
The doctor gave a frank assessment of the patient's chances of recovery.
پزشک ارزیابی صریحی از شانس بهبودی بیمار ارائه داد.
miniContext: Being frank means speaking honestly and directly, even when the truth might be uncomfortable. A frank conversation between coworkers can resolve a misunderstanding faster than weeks of polite silence. Critics respected the director for giving frank interviews instead of vague, rehearsed answers. Sometimes a frank opinion, even an unwelcome one, is exactly what a friend needs to hear.

examples: His whisper was barely audible over the noise of the crowd.
پچ‌پچ او در میان سر و صدای جمعیت به‌سختی قابل شنیدن بود.
The teacher raised her voice to make sure she stayed audible at the back of the hall.
معلم صدایش را بالا برد تا مطمئن شود در انتهای سالن هم قابل شنیدن است.
A soft click, audible only to those standing nearby, signaled that the lock had opened.
یک کلیک آرام، که فقط برای افراد نزدیک قابل شنیدن بود، نشان داد که قفل باز شده است.
miniContext: Audible describes a sound that can actually be heard, as opposed to one that's too quiet or distant. In a crowded subway car, even a shout can barely be audible. Sound engineers adjust microphones carefully so that every instrument stays audible during a live concert. The faint, barely audible creak of the floorboard was the only warning that someone had entered the room.

examples: She received an urgent message asking her to call the hospital immediately.
او پیامی فوری دریافت کرد که از او خواسته بود فوراً با بیمارستان تماس بگیرد.
The leak in the roof became urgent after last night's heavy rain.
نشتی سقف بعد از باران شدید شب گذشته فوری و حیاتی شد.
There is an urgent need for more volunteers at the shelter this winter.
امسال زمستان نیاز فوری به داوطلبان بیشتر در پناهگاه وجود دارد.
miniContext: Something urgent demands attention right away because waiting could make things worse. An urgent email from a client usually gets answered before anything else on the to-do list. A sudden toothache late at night can feel urgent even if it isn't a true emergency. Nurses are trained to recognize which patients need urgent care first.

examples: Urban areas tend to have higher rents than smaller towns nearby.
مناطق شهری معمولاً نسبت به شهرهای کوچک نزدیک اجاره بالاتری دارند.
The city launched a new urban planning project to add more green spaces.
شهر یک پروژه جدید برنامه‌ریزی شهری برای افزودن فضای سبز بیشتر راه‌اندازی کرد.
Urban wildlife, like raccoons and foxes, has adapted surprisingly well to city life.
حیات وحش شهری، مانند راکون‌ها و روباه‌ها، به‌طرز شگفت‌آوری با زندگی شهری سازگار شده است.
miniContext: Urban refers to anything related to cities, as opposed to rural or suburban areas. Urban life often means shorter commutes but smaller living spaces. City planners debate how to balance urban growth with the need for parks and green space. Urban farming, growing food on rooftops and in vacant lots, has become popular in many large cities.

examples: A single spark was enough to ignite the dry grass along the highway.
فقط یک جرقه کافی بود تا علف‌های خشک کنار بزرگراه را آتش بزند.
The coach's halftime speech managed to ignite the team's confidence for the second half.
سخنرانی مربی در نیمه‌وقت توانست اعتمادبه‌نفس تیم را برای نیمه دوم شعله‌ور کند.
Firefighters warned that even a cigarette could ignite the dry forest in this heat.
آتش‌نشانان هشدار دادند که حتی یک سیگار هم می‌تواند در این گرما جنگل خشک را آتش بزند.
miniContext: To ignite means to set something on fire or, more broadly, to spark a strong reaction. A tiny spark from old wiring was enough to ignite the entire barn. A passionate speech can ignite excitement in a crowd that seemed bored just minutes earlier. Firefighters remind campers that dry leaves can ignite instantly near an unattended campfire.

examples: The new law will prohibit smoking in all public parks starting next month.
قانون جدید از ماه آینده سیگار کشیدن در تمام پارک‌های عمومی را ممنوع خواهد کرد.
School rules prohibit students from using phones during exams.
قوانین مدرسه استفاده دانش‌آموزان از تلفن در طول امتحانات را ممنوع می‌کند.
The landlord's contract prohibits tenants from keeping pets in the apartment.
قرارداد صاحب‌خانه نگهداری حیوان خانگی در آپارتمان را برای مستأجرها ممنوع می‌کند.
miniContext: To prohibit something means to officially forbid it, usually through a rule or law. City regulations prohibit loud construction work before seven in the morning. Many airlines prohibit passengers from bringing large liquids through security. The club's bylaws prohibit members from bringing guests without advance notice.

examples: Factories along the river continue to pollute the water with untreated waste.
کارخانه‌های کنار رودخانه همچنان آب را با پسماند تصفیه‌نشده آلوده می‌کنند.
Old diesel engines pollute the air far more than modern electric cars.
موتورهای دیزلی قدیمی هوا را بسیار بیشتر از خودروهای برقی مدرن آلوده می‌کنند.
Residents demanded that the company stop polluting the local groundwater.
ساکنان خواستند که شرکت آلوده کردن آب‌های زیرزمینی محلی را متوقف کند.
miniContext: To pollute means to make air, water, or soil dirty and harmful, usually through waste or chemicals. Cargo ships can pollute coastal waters when they leak fuel during routine operations. Cities are passing stricter rules to stop factories from polluting nearby rivers. Even small amounts of plastic can pollute an entire beach over several years.

examples: Doctors advise patients to decrease their salt intake to lower blood pressure.
پزشکان به بیماران توصیه می‌کنند مصرف نمک خود را کاهش دهند تا فشار خونشان پایین بیاید.
Sales tend to decrease sharply right after the holiday shopping season ends.
فروش معمولاً بلافاصله بعد از پایان فصل خرید تعطیلات به‌شدت کاهش می‌یابد.
The company reported a steady decrease in customer complaints over the past year.
شرکت کاهش پیوسته‌ای در شکایات مشتریان طی سال گذشته گزارش داد.
miniContext: A decrease is a reduction in size, amount, or number. Doctors recommend a gradual decrease in sugar intake rather than cutting it out all at once. The company saw a sharp decrease in profits after losing its biggest client. As remote work grew more common, traffic during rush hour began to decrease in many cities.

examples: Lawmakers voted to abolish the outdated tax on small businesses.
قانون‌گذاران رأی دادند تا مالیات قدیمی بر کسب‌وکارهای کوچک را لغو کنند.
Reformers worked for decades to abolish child labor in factories.
اصلاح‌طلبان دهه‌ها کار کردند تا کار کودکان در کارخانه‌ها را لغو کنند.
The new principal decided to abolish the old dress code policy.
مدیر جدید تصمیم گرفت سیاست قدیمی کد پوشش را لغو کند.
miniContext: To abolish something means to officially end it, usually a law, system, or practice. Many countries have worked to abolish outdated laws that no longer reflect modern values. The new government promised to abolish the unpopular toll on the old bridge. Historians study the long struggle to abolish slavery as one of the most important movements of the era.

examples: The population of the small town has doubled in just ten years.
جمعیت آن شهر کوچک فقط در ده سال دو برابر شده است.
Scientists are studying how the fish population has changed in the lake.
دانشمندان در حال بررسی این هستند که جمعیت ماهی‌ها در دریاچه چگونه تغییر کرده است.
A large portion of the population relies on public transportation to get to work.
بخش بزرگی از جمعیت برای رفتن به محل کار به حمل‌ونقل عمومی تکیه دارد.
miniContext: Population refers to the number of people, or sometimes animals, living in a particular place. The population of the coastal city has grown rapidly due to new job opportunities. Conservationists track the population of endangered species to measure how well protection efforts are working. A shrinking population can create economic challenges for small rural towns.

examples: The magician refused to reveal how the trick was done.
شعبده‌باز حاضر نشد نحوه انجام آن ترفند را آشکار کند.
The company plans to reveal its new logo at next week's conference.
شرکت قصد دارد لوگوی جدیدش را در کنفرانس هفته آینده آشکار کند.
New test results reveal a surprising link between diet and energy levels.
نتایج جدید آزمایش ارتباط شگفت‌آوری بین رژیم غذایی و سطح انرژی را آشکار می‌کند.
miniContext: To reveal means to make something known that was previously hidden or secret. The documentary promises to reveal new details about the shipwreck's final hours. A good mystery novel waits until the last few pages to reveal the culprit. Her nervous smile began to reveal just how worried she really was.

examples: The small apartment didn't have adequate space for a family of five.
آن آپارتمان کوچک فضای کافی برای یک خانواده پنج‌نفره نداشت.
Workers complained that the training they received wasn't adequate for the new equipment.
کارگران شکایت کردند که آموزشی که دریافت کرده بودند برای تجهیزات جدید کافی نبود.
The team made sure there was adequate lighting before starting the night shift.
تیم مطمئن شد که قبل از شروع شیفت شب، روشنایی مناسبی وجود دارد.
miniContext: Adequate means enough to meet a particular need, though not necessarily more than that. The hikers made sure they packed adequate food and water for the two-day trip. Critics argued that the school's funding was barely adequate to cover basic supplies. An adequate explanation doesn't have to be perfect, just clear enough for people to understand.
